title: A $0.00 credit never blocks reversing the invoice
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced, billable, whose line 2 was No Charge under Goodwill, with a $0.00 credit issued for line 2's part.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Reverse the invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The invoice shows.

Step 3:

  • The invoice is reversed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-E7: “After invoicing, a part of a no-charge line goes back through Issue Credit like any part: Issue Credit lists it at a $0.00 credit that cannot be edited and with no restocking fee (nothing was charged), the part returns to inventory, and its cost is reversed from the category account to inventory with the same entry a return on an internal work order uses. The $0.00 credit never blocks an invoice reversal.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
